name: What are the typical costs involved in building a guest home in San Diego County?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs involved in building a guest home in San Diego County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a guest home can vary significantly based on size, complexity, materials, and site conditions. Factors like foundation work, utility hookups, and finishes all influence the final price. While a precise estimate requires a detailed consultation, typical ranges can start from around $100,000 for smaller, simpler units and go upwards for larger or more custom builds. Permitting fees, architectural designs, and impact fees will also contribute to the overall budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a guest home vary widely by size, materials, and site conditions, generally starting from $100,000 in San Diego County, plus permitting and design fees.
